name: GPG Connect
description: A custom devcontainer feature that allows the importing of public GPG keys from provided source files on the host machine. This feature is two-fold and is separated into the exporting and importing of GPG keys. The first part of the process is exporting the public GPG keys from the host machine. The second part of this process is importing the keys and that's where this feature comes in. This feature reads these files and attempts to automatically configure git to use any provided key(s) for signing.
